text.arabic_uthmani: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ

words.gloss_range: negating particle that opens a no-except restriction over the whole calamity statement
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the ayah by launching a no-except restriction rather than a question or relative clause. Its scope stretches across the event, the two experienced domains, and the later exception, so the reader first hears total exclusion before the register is named. The lengthened opening sound makes the negation itself a marked entry into the decree statement.

topics.headline: opening no-except restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first word controls a long restriction frame: no calamity is left outside the later exception.
topics.reason: The local construction is the negative half of the no-except frame and is resolved by the later exception particle.

topics.headline: lengthened negating launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the negation as a marked opening sound before the strike verb arrives.
topics.reason: The form and sound rows add a local launch-point payoff without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: completed befalling or striking occurrence under negation, with target-reaching force narrowed by the calamity subject
words.root_gloss_range: root range of hitting, reaching, descending, and correctness; the local Form IV calamity frame selects befalling with directed arrival pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أَصَابَ}} ({{tr:aṣāba}}) is the first lexical action: a completed befalling under negation. The active, preposed masculine Form IV verb lets the strike-event stand first before the feminine calamity subject appears, and the same verb stretches across the three repeated locative phrases so experienced location and inscriptional location remain one event-frame. The following calamity noun narrows the wider reaching and hitting field toward affliction that arrives at its domain. The cognate reprise with the later noun makes the event feel directed before the book-register contains it.

topics.headline: active completed strike event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah opens through a completed active befalling event whose one verb holds the earth, selves, and register phrases together before divine agency is named.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect Form IV and preposed before its delayed feminine subject.

topics.headline: target-reaching affliction pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels calamity as something that reaches its domain with directed arrival, while local context keeps the selected sense as befalling affliction.
topics.reason: The broader root range is real, but the calamity subject narrows it to befalling with target-reaching pressure.

topics.headline: Form IV completed occurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the chosen form states realized cases already covered by the register, not an ongoing process.
topics.reason: The Form IV perfect surface is locally licensed and supports the completed occurrence reading.

topics.headline: verb-noun strike reprise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the same strike-root return as action and event-noun, intensifying the occurrence before the register contains it.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows point to local root reprise and audible texture within this ayah.

topics.headline: reward pursuit turns to governed occurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from racing toward reward to an impersonal statement about what befalls.
topics.reason: The boundary row coheres with the new ayah opening on an event verb.

words.gloss_range: emphatic preposition after negation, universalizing the following indefinite calamity noun
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) is grammatically bound to the indefinite calamity noun, so it is not a loose intensifier. In the negative environment it presses the phrase toward not even a single calamity, making the later exception absolute rather than merely illustrative. Its ordinary source or partitive range survives only as background to that universalizing force.

topics.headline: not any calamity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle makes the negation granular: not a single member of the calamity class escapes.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the indefinite noun under negation and functions as emphatic universalizing min.

topics.headline: from-range behind universal scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps a faint partitive or source pressure while the local negative frame selects emphatic universalization.
topics.reason: The wider particle range is narrowed by the negative context.

topics.headline: restriction strengthened before exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the particle strengthens the exclusion side before the exception resolves the claim.
topics.reason: The row fits the no-except restriction mechanism.

words.gloss_range: any calamity or strike-event, indefinite under negation and shaped as a countable event that reaches its domain
words.root_gloss_range: root range of hitting, reaching, descending, and correctness; the local noun selects calamity as an event that reaches or strikes
words.prose: {{ar:مُصِيبَةٍ}} ({{tr:muṣībatin}}) supplies the delayed subject after the strike verb and emphatic particle. Its indefinite, countable form under negation makes the class exhaustive: any calamity whatsoever. Because the noun is shaped from the same strike-root, the calamity is not inert material but an event that reaches or hits before being located in earth, selves, and register.

topics.headline: delayed indefinite calamity class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject arrives after the verb and particle as an exhaustive any-calamity class.
topics.reason: The noun is delayed, genitive after the particle, and indefinite under negation.

topics.headline: calamity as striking event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the calamity as an event that hits or reaches, while the local noun remains the conventional calamity sense.
topics.reason: The active-participle and root evidence preserve arrival-force without replacing the local calamity reading.

topics.headline: local strike-root echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the verb and noun reinforce each other as strike and strike-event before the domains unfold.
topics.reason: The local repetition and indefinite cadence are directly tied to the surface wording.

words.gloss_range: locative containment preposition marking the earth as the first domain where calamity may strike
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) attaches the strike to the earth-domain as a location, not a source or instrument. This first containment phrase establishes the prepositional template that will be repeated for selves and then transformed for the written register.

topics.headline: first locative container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first domain is presented as where calamity strikes, setting the pattern for the later containers.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the earth phrase as a locative complement and begins the repeated containment sequence.

words.gloss_range: the recognized earth as the external domain of affliction, paired with the addressed inner selves rather than a heaven-pair in the standard surface
words.root_gloss_range: root range around earth, ground, land, low terrestrial domain, and related bodily/illness traces; the local reading selects the recognized external terrestrial domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) names the known terrestrial domain as the first place where calamity may strike. Its definite singular form gathers external places into one outside field, with ground and lowness pressure making the affliction land in the lower terrestrial layer. The standard wording then moves from that field to selves rather than completing a heaven-earth axis, while the rare illness trace in the root field sharpens the turn toward inner affliction without replacing the local earth sense. The boundary with the prior ayah also flips earth from reward-scale into affliction-domain.

topics.headline: recognized external earth-domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth is the comprehensive outside field, not a local territory or actor.
topics.reason: The definite singular genitive noun is governed by the first locative preposition.

topics.headline: earth paired with selves, not heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the standard wording choose an external-internal pair; ground/lowness pressure and variant evidence sharpen that move, while the possible heaven-axis does not govern the canonical parse.
topics.reason: The local text pairs earth with selves, while the variant functions as contrast rather than replacement.

topics.headline: earth shifts from reward scale to affliction site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same earth-thread crossing the boundary with a reversed role, from reward scale to calamity domain.
topics.reason: Boundary and echo rows cohere with the same lexeme's local reuse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that joins the second locative domain without collapsing it into the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the second locative domain into the same negated event frame. With the following negative particle it forms a nor-connection, making the inner domain parallel to earth while keeping the two phrases distinct.

topics.headline: second domain coordinated as nor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a tiny connector carries the self-domain into a parallel neither-nor architecture.
topics.reason: The conjunction works with the following negative particle to coordinate the second locative phrase.

words.gloss_range: renewed negative particle inside the coordinated phrase, explicitly extending negation to the self-domain
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) renews the negation before the self-domain without starting a new verb. The second domain is therefore not only implied by the opening negation; it receives its own audible boundary inside the larger no-except frame.

topics.headline: self-domain explicitly re-negated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inner affliction receives its own negative marking rather than being left implicit.
topics.reason: The particle negates the following locative phrase under the same event verb.

words.gloss_range: repeated locative preposition shifting the same containment frame from earth to the addressed selves
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) repeats the first locative governor but changes the object from external earth to the addressed selves. The same containment preposition now becomes interior, helping the ayah move from geographic space to personal experience before the third containment in the register.

topics.headline: same preposition turns inward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same container grammar shift from external earth to interior selves.
topics.reason: The repeated locative preposition governs the self-domain and links the first two domains before the register.

words.gloss_range: your selves as a possessed, plural inner domain where affliction can be located, spanning embodied and personal experience
words.root_gloss_range: root range of self, soul, breath, person, desire, preciousness, relief, and competition; the local plural possessed form selects the addressed living selves as inner domain
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْفُسِكُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusikum}}) completes the external-internal pair by making your own selves the second domain of affliction. The plural possessed form gathers the addressed community into one inner field, while the root's self, breath, desire, and preciousness range makes that field embodied and value-laden. Same-surah and affliction parallels reinforce the shift from human agency to human reception of what is already inscribed.

topics.headline: your selves as affected domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the decree reaches the addressed community's own inner lives, not only the world outside them.
topics.reason: The plural possessed noun is governed by the locative preposition and completes the external-internal binary.

topics.headline: living self range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the affected domain as embodied, desiring, precious selfhood, while local grammar keeps it as the locative self-domain.
topics.reason: The broader root field survives as pressure around the selected self/person sense.

topics.headline: self-domain in affliction and divine frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the self-domain tied to affliction, book, earth, and divine relation across the supplied recurrence fields.
topics.reason: The contextual and cross-reference rows support the local role of selves as affected interior domain.

topics.headline: sound binds preposition to selves
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the inner-domain phrase as a compact unit, reinforcing the tight locative attachment.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a local audible payoff tied to the governed phrase.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that resolves the no-except frame and pivots from negated domains to written containment
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hard hinge of the ayah. It resolves the suspended negation and turns the claim from no calamity in earth or selves into the sole positive assertion: every such event is in a register. The exception is a prepositional phrase, so the payoff is not just that calamity is known, but that it has an inscriptional locus.

topics.headline: pivot from negation to register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah turns at this particle from no unrecorded calamity to the single positive locus of inscription.
topics.reason: The exception particle resolves the no-except frame and is followed by a prepositional register phrase.

words.gloss_range: third locative preposition, transferring containment from experienced domains to the written register
words.prose: {{ar:فِي}} ({{tr:fī}}) appears for the third time, now before the written register. Because the same preposition has already held earth and selves as containers of experience, this occurrence makes the book feel like the controlling container of inscription. The sequence moves physical space, personal space, then written space.

topics.headline: containment moves into book
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated container preposition become metaphorical and controlling when it reaches the written register.
topics.reason: The same locative preposition governs the register after governing earth and selves.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite written register or decree-record that contains calamity before creation, with binding as well as recording force
words.root_gloss_range: root range of writing, inscription, binding, joining, decree, prescription, and record; the local indefinite noun selects a prior inscriptional register with decree force
words.prose: {{ar:كِتَابٍ}} ({{tr:kitābin}}) is the positive content after the exception: a register in which calamity is already held. Its indefiniteness leaves the decree-record open rather than naming a title, while the root's writing and binding field makes the record active as ordered decree, not merely archive. The word gathers the ayah's earth, selves, and divine-name fields into one prior inscriptional frame, and it joins wider pre-recording register language (6:59, 10:61, 11:6, 22:70, 35:11). The following before-phrase pushes that register behind the act of creation itself.

topics.headline: indefinite register after exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exception's positive answer is a register, indefinite yet grammatically fixed as the locus of containment.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and then temporally qualified by the before-phrase.

topics.headline: writing as binding decree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the register as inscribing and binding events into ordered decree, while the local noun remains a written record rather than a separate writing act.
topics.reason: The root dispute and lexical range support writing, binding, decree, and prescription pressure, narrowed to this register noun.

topics.headline: decree record joins wider writtenness field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this register to the ayah's earth, selves, and divine-name fields and to wider pre-recording register language (6:59, 10:61, 11:6, 22:70, 35:11) without replacing the local indefinite form.
topics.reason: The recurrence and boundary rows support the local register as part of a broader divine writtenness pattern.

topics.headline: tanwīn links register and ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the indefinite cadence tie the register to the final ease predicate.
topics.reason: The sound row is local and directly tied to the word's ending.

words.gloss_range: temporal source preposition in the compound before-phrase, distinct from the earlier emphatic particle
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) repeats the earlier particle with a different job. Here it governs the before-word and marks temporal origin, so the ayah mirrors one surface form while moving from universal scope to pre-creation priority.

topics.headline: from-before temporal source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same particle now marks temporal priority rather than universalizing the calamity class.
topics.reason: The particle governs the before-word and forms a temporal compound.

words.gloss_range: before-priority that qualifies the register as anterior to the divine act of bringing the referent into existence
words.root_gloss_range: root range of before, facing, frontness, receiving, accepting, and orientation; the local temporal noun selects anteriority with facing-priority pressure
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلِ}} ({{tr:qabli}}) turns the book phrase into a temporal claim: the register is before the divine bringing-into-existence. Its front-facing root pressure makes the priorness concrete, as if the record stands ahead of what will appear and intercepts the strike-event before its occurrence. The same-surah before-language and book-before recurrence deepen here from historical priority to cosmological anteriority.

topics.headline: register before creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the before-word makes the register anterior to the divine creation act, not merely prior to occurrence.
topics.reason: The temporal noun is governed by the preceding particle and completed by the following creation clause.

topics.headline: before as facing priority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels priorness as an oriented front-facing relation, while local grammar selects temporal before.
topics.reason: The broader root range of facing and receiving is narrowed to temporal anteriority with image pressure.

topics.headline: history-before deepens to creation-before
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees same-surah and wider book-before language deepen here into pre-creation priority, with the before-frame intercepting the strike before occurrence.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows support the local scale shift.

topics.headline: compressed before-clause sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the before-clause as a compact hinge binding register to creation timing.
topics.reason: The sound row adds a local cadence payoff.

words.gloss_range: subordinating verbal-noun particle that makes the creation verb the complement of the before-phrase
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) prevents the following creation verb from becoming an independent new clause. It nominalizes the divine action into the complement of before, so the ayah can say that inscription precedes the event of Our bringing it forth.

topics.headline: creation made complement of before
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine action is subordinated as the reference event for prior inscription.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following verb and makes a verbal-noun-like complement.

words.gloss_range: We bring it into distinct existence, with a feminine object suffix whose antecedent remains broad enough to hold calamity, earth, selves, or the created referent
words.root_gloss_range: root range of creating, originating, separating into existence, clearing, innocence, and healing; the local Form I verb selects divine origination with clearing and distinctness pressure
words.prose: {{ar:نَبْرَأَهَا}} ({{tr:nabraʾahā}}) shifts the sentence from impersonal striking to divine first-person agency. The Form I creation verb selects origination, while the root's clearing, innocence, healing, and separating pressures make the act feel like bringing the referent into distinct existence. The attached feminine suffix keeps multiple antecedents in play, and the root also resonates with the divine Originator name field (59:24). The hamza catch inside the verb marks the creation point, where the preceding report about God becomes divine self-disclosure within the sentence.

topics.headline: divine We creates the referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from impersonal event to divine first-person agency, with the object suffix keeping the referent tightly attached.
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under the particle, first-person plural, and bears a feminine object suffix.

topics.headline: distinct origination with clearing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels creation as bringing into distinct existence, while healing and innocence senses remain root pressure rather than the selected local sense.
topics.reason: The local Form I verb selects origination; broader clearing and healing senses qualify the image without replacing it.

topics.headline: creation verb resonates with divine originator field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the divine We with the named God that follows and with the Originator root echo (59:24).
topics.reason: The supplied rows give the divine-name field and concrete cross-reference while local grammar keeps the verb in this ayah.

topics.headline: creation point closes the decree beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the creation verb, including its hamza catch, as the point where prior inscription meets bringing into existence and report about God becomes divine self-disclosure.
topics.reason: The sound, boundary, and synthesis rows converge on the same local creation hinge.

words.gloss_range: emphatic clause-opening particle that turns the preceding system into confirmed news about divine ease
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the final emphatic tail. It makes the preceding pre-inscription system confirmed news and prepares the clause that will explain how such a sweeping claim is possible: it is easy for God.

topics.headline: confirmed closing capacity claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a new emphatic clause that confirms and explains the sweeping pre-inscription claim.
topics.reason: The particle governs the demonstrative and launches the final ease clause.

words.gloss_range: distant demonstrative packaging the whole pre-inscription proposition as the subject of the closing ease claim
words.prose: {{ar:ذَلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) compresses the whole preceding proposition into one demonstrative subject. Its masculine singular form does not point to a nearby feminine noun; it packages the entire system at conceptual distance so the final predicate can evaluate it.

topics.headline: that packages the whole system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative points to the entire preceding proposition, not to one nearby noun.
topics.reason: The masculine singular distant demonstrative functions as the governed subject of the emphatic clause.

words.gloss_range: preposition of uponness shifted into a capacity relation: the whole matter is easy for God
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) keeps the ease claim in a visible prepositional relation. The uponness field is not burden here, because the final adjective inverts it into effortless capacity: the vast system rests lightly with God. Its placement lets the divine reference point arrive before the final verdict.

topics.headline: uponness becomes effortless capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition keeps a relation of what rests with God, but the final adjective turns any burden pressure into ease.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the divine name as complement of the final ease predicate.

words.gloss_range: the proper divine name as the governed reference point for ease, resolving the earlier divine We and grounding the claim in named divinity
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field tied to deity, worship, devotion, awe, and contested exaltedness derivations; locally the proper name is governed by the ease construction
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) names the divine referent after the earlier first-person plural act. Grammatically the name is governed by the preposition, so God is the calibrated reference point for ease rather than the subject of a new verb. The proper name brings worship, deity, and awe into the closure, gathers the strike, book, and ease fields under one named divine referent, and links this statement to the wider easy-for-God formula (33:19, 33:30, 35:11, 57:22, 64:7).

topics.headline: proper name grounds the ease clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earlier divine We is resolved by the proper divine name, which becomes the reference point for ease.
topics.reason: The divine name is genitive under the preposition and prepares the final predicate.

topics.headline: worship and awe in the proper name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ease claim as grounded in named divinity, while contested derivations remain pressure around the proper name rather than a new local parse.
topics.reason: The derivational rows are kept as semantic pressure but narrowed by the proper-name function.

topics.headline: easy-for-God formula and surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closure to a recognized divine-capacity formula, the surrounding divine-name thread, and the ayah's strike-book-ease fields.
topics.reason: The recurrence rows include concrete formula references and same-surah continuity.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite predicate of ease, smoothness, and lightness for God, closing the entire pre-inscription claim
words.root_gloss_range: root range of ease, smoothness, accessibility, smallness, leftness, affluence, and lot-casting associations; the local adjective selects unburdensome divine ease while retaining lightness and ready-access pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَسِيرٌ}} ({{tr:yasīrun}}) lands as the final predicate: the whole pre-inscription system is easy for God. Its indefinite adjective form states a quality rather than a new act of facilitation, and the root's smoothness, accessibility, lightness, abundance, and apparent chance fields make the ease concrete while leaving no difficulty counterpart for God. After the prior ayah's immense bounty (57:21), the ending makes what is immense to recipients light for God. The ayah moves from total negation and calamity to a final diminuendo of effortless divine capacity.

topics.headline: final predicate of ease
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by evaluating the whole pre-inscription system as easy for God.
topics.reason: The adjective is the predicate of the emphatic demonstrative clause and is calibrated by the preceding prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: smooth accessible lightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels divine ease as smooth, light, readily accessible capacity, with apparent chance and the prior immense-bounty contrast (57:21) kept as narrowed image pressure.
topics.reason: The local adjective selects ease; broader root domains add pressure without becoming independent local senses.

topics.headline: scope resolved as effortless capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the opening universal scope resolved by a divine-capacity formula: the vast system is not burdensome for God.
topics.reason: The recurrence, boundary, and synthesis rows tie final ease to the ayah's whole movement.

topics.headline: final light cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final word's cadence match the semantic reduction from calamity to ease.
topics.reason: The sound row is local and supports the final landing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ص و ب in the verb and event noun, distributed across earth and selves.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb-noun echo makes the occurrence a directed arrival that reaches a landing domain; earth and selves supply external and embodied targets rather than two unrelated classes.

activation_trace.role: Aiming and reaching a target supplies the directed path by which the occurrence arrives.
A contingency taking a person identifies the arrival as an afflictive event rather than neutral motion.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the event's public and material landing field.
The very identity of a thing supplies the personal and inward landing field.

changed_reading.before: A bad event merely happens somewhere in the world or to a person.
changed_reading.after: An afflictive occurrence reaches a specified landing field, whether the shared material world or the person's own embodied identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كتاب, من قبل, and نبرأها.
baseline_models.mechanism: Fixing in a record is placed prior to creative bringing-forth, so inscription and occurrence are two stages: determination first, instantiated event second.

activation_trace.role: An established determination or decree supplies the antecedent fixed stage.
Temporal precedence orders the fixed stage ahead of the event's emergence.
Creating and bringing into existence supplies the later instantiation stage.

changed_reading.before: The book is a retrospective archive of events.
changed_reading.after: The book is antecedent determination from which the event is subsequently brought into created existence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كتاب before the creation of the feminine event referent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book's joining image permits the event to be read as a pre-composed configuration of time, place, and affected self rather than an isolated datum.

activation_trace.role: Joining one part to another supplies a composed relation among the event's conditions.
Precedence locates that composition before its realized form.
Creative existence converts the composed relation into an occurrence.

changed_reading.before: Each calamity is a single entry stored in a container.
changed_reading.after: Each calamity can be a prejoined configuration whose related conditions are instantiated together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing assessment that this is easy for God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Ease evaluates the divine work of prior inscription and bringing-forth; it does not evaluate the sufferer's experience of the affliction.

activation_trace.role: Readiness and ease after difficulty characterize execution from the divine actor's side.
Smallness supplies a low-burden assessment of the operation, not of the human loss.

changed_reading.before: The closing word risks sounding as though the calamity itself is slight.
changed_reading.after: What is slight in burden is the exhaustive inscription-and-creation operation relative to God, not the affliction relative to its recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assertion of unrestricted capacity and the closing denial that people control divine bounty turn يسير into an actor-relative capacity claim. The contrast protects the line from minimizing pain.

activation_trace.role: Ease and ready execution anchor the assessment in the focus verse.
Effective capacity to perform and possess supplies the divine side of the asymmetry.
The same capacity image, denied to people over divine bounty, supplies the human side of the asymmetry.

structural_cues: The surah frames the focus between an early positive capacity claim and a late negative human-capacity claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine capacity, human non-control, and focus-verse ease; I infer that ease measures actor capacity rather than sufferer impact. A live alternative is that the closing adjective simply reassures without making the asymmetry explicit.

changed_reading.before: The operation, or even the calamity, is generically easy.
changed_reading.after: Comprehensive pre-inscription and enactment impose no strain on God even though humans neither control the dispensation nor experience every event as slight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus event's directed arrival is placed inside a larger traffic system: things enter earth, emerge from it, descend, and ascend. The event is therefore readable as a tracked boundary-crossing in a governed circulation rather than an isolated interruption.

activation_trace.role: Descent from above and settlement supplies the focus event's arrival vector.
Entry into another body supplies the inward boundary crossing of the circulation.
Passage to the outside supplies the earth-to-outward return leg.
Descent and settlement parallels the focus root's downward arrival.
Ascent supplies the counter-motion that closes the circulation rather than leaving descent one-way.

structural_cues: Four parallel relative clauses balance entry, exit, descent, and ascent around earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the motion pairs and the focus root's descent/target images; I infer a common governed traffic model linking them. The alternative is that the motion list establishes only the scope of divine knowledge, without classifying calamity as circulation.

changed_reading.before: A calamity is a random-looking blow that interrupts the world's normal flow.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival can be read as one tracked crossing within the same ordered ingress, emergence, descent, and ascent that structure the world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actions before and after an opening are morally differentiated, while people are commanded to race toward a destination already prepared. Prior determination and urgent consequential action therefore coexist rather than cancel one another.

activation_trace.role: Antecedent determination supplies the apparent pressure toward passivity that context revises.
Temporal precedence marks an action window whose timing still changes moral rank.
Advancing in a race supplies active urgency inside an already ordered horizon.
Making something ready supplies a prepared destination that still calls forth racing.

structural_cues: The before/after comparison assigns unequal rank to the same actions.
An imperative to race is juxtaposed with a passive statement of prior preparation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior writing, morally weighted timing, racing, and preparation; I infer that preparedness is compatible with meaningful agency. The live alternative is that the focus inscription covers calamities only and says nothing directly about acts.

changed_reading.before: Being written before creation suggests that present action is causally or morally idle.
changed_reading.after: Prior ordering sets the horizon within which timely action remains urgent and differentially consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth is revived, receives descending rain, sends out growth, and ends in dry fragments. Against that cycle, an occurrence in earth can be a transition in a generative-decay process, not only a foreign blow imposed on a static surface.

activation_trace.role: Rain-like descent and settlement connect the focus occurrence to the earthly cycle.
Soft productive earth supplies the transforming substrate rather than a mere location label.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the regenerative phase.
Dead land without life supplies the dormant phase from which change begins.
Life-giving descent from the sky supplies the initiating input.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the visible growth phase.
Dry matter breaking into fragments supplies the terminal disintegration phase.

structural_cues: The rain example unfolds as a temporal sequence from descent through growth to fragmentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revived earth and the rain-growth-fragment sequence; I infer that the focus occurrence can mark a transition within that cycle. The alternative is that this sequence analogizes worldly life only and does not broaden مصيبة itself.

changed_reading.before: A calamity in earth is an external shock striking a passive location.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a created threshold in an earth process whose descent, emergence, flourishing, and breakdown are all ordered phases.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following purpose clause pairs what escapes reach with what is given and pairs grief with exultant joy. That turns prior inscription into an affective calibration device: arrivals and misses are decentered without denying their reality.

activation_trace.role: Aiming and reaching a target establishes the focus side of the hit/miss relation.
Antecedent determination supplies the cognitive frame used to regulate response.
Grief and consolation supply the contracted response to what has escaped.
Failure to reach or attain supplies the miss-side counterpart to the focus event's hit.
Boastful, overfull joy supplies the expansive response that requires restraint.
Giving supplies the arrival-side counterpart to what escapes possession.

structural_cues: The verse after the focus opens with a purpose marker and balances two negative response clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit purpose construction, target-reaching in the focus, and miss/gift plus grief/exultation afterward; I infer that the doctrine functions therapeutically by loosening possessive affect. The alternative is a narrower ethical consequence without a hit/miss mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse chiefly reports the ontology of prior recording.
changed_reading.after: Prior recording is also an affective practice: it prevents a miss from becoming consuming grief and a receipt from becoming possessive triumph.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later book is conjoined with a balance so that people rise for equity. This activates a calibrated public-order resonance in the focus book: the record may situate events within measure and relation, not merely list private fates.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts supplies the focus book as an ordered relational composition.
A written book supplies the publicly communicated ordering term in the later cluster.
A balance of justice supplies calibration alongside the book.
Rising resolutely to an affair supplies enacted social consequence rather than inert recordkeeping.
Justice and fair dealing supply the public end toward which book and balance operate.

structural_cues: Book and balance are coordinated, followed by a purpose clause about collective standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the later book-balance-equity cluster; I infer a resonance between that book and the focus book as ordered measure. The live alternative is that revealed scripture and the antecedent event record are distinct senses whose functions should not transfer.

changed_reading.before: The focus book is only a private ledger of predetermined losses.
changed_reading.after: It can additionally evoke a calibrated order in which occurrences are related and measured, while the public-equity transfer remains exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distinguishes a humanly originated practice from what was prescribed and still evaluates whether that practice was duly maintained. Writing therefore cannot be flattened into an all-purpose claim that every initiative is compelled or that responsibility disappears.

activation_trace.role: Established determination anchors the focus claim that context prevents from becoming totalizing fatalism.
Originating something without a prior model supplies the human initiative distinguished from prescription.
Prescriptive establishment supplies the category explicitly contrasted with that innovation.
Attentive observance supplies the continuing criterion by which the human practice is judged.

structural_cues: The later verse places innovation, negated prescription, and failed observance in one causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a distinction between human origination and divine prescription plus retained accountability; I infer that focus-verse writing should not be universalized into fatalism. The alternative is that prescriptive writing and event recording are categorically separate, limiting the corrective to analogy.

changed_reading.before: Prior writing can be generalized into the claim that every human initiative is compelled and responsibility is emptied out.
changed_reading.after: The surah differentiates what is written from what people originate and still judges their care, so the focus claim orders occurrences without erasing accountable response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the construction with أن strongly selects temporal 'before.' It remains worth carrying as a conceptual overlay because the same ق ب ل inventory and a nearby inside/outside boundary scene activate the root's directional 'from the side of' branch. Downstream prose should say that the book also evokes an upstream or source-side position relative to creation, never replace the temporal translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: من قبل أن نبرأها, especially the branch range of ق ب ل.

activation_trace.role: Direction or provenance supplies an upstream-side overlay to the grammatically temporal phrase.
An enclosing elevated wall supplies the boundary across which sides are distinguished.
The inside of a thing supplies one face of the directional contrast.
Outward visibility supplies the opposing face of the boundary.
Provenance from a side directly instantiates the contextual branch that reactivates the overlay.

changed_reading.before: The record exists earlier than creation in a purely chronological relation.
changed_reading.after: Alongside temporal priority, the record can be imagined as lying on the upstream or source side from which the event crosses into created manifestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant ن ص ب mapping for focus ص و ب. It remains anchored through that supplied mapping and becomes mechanistically coherent beside measure and apportioned share in 57:25. Downstream prose must present it only as an associative possibility: what hits may feel like an assigned allotment, not as a replacement etymology or a claim that suffering is distributively just.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping of the doubled focus root ص و ب to a ن ص ب branch of assigned share.

activation_trace.role: A designated share raised for its recipient supplies the exploratory allotment image for what arrives.
Estimating by weight supplies the operation that measures the possible allotment.
A divided share or portion supplies the resulting allotment category.

changed_reading.before: A calamity simply strikes its target.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, what strikes can also appear as a measured share arriving at its designated place, without implying that its human distribution is visibly equitable.

strongest_changes: The immediate purpose clause converts prior inscription into a hit/miss discipline for grief and possessive exultation.
Ingress, emergence, descent, ascent, and the rain-to-fragments cycle recast an occurrence as a governed transition within world processes.
Prepared destinations, morally weighted timing, and the later distinction between prescription and innovation block a passive fatalist reading.
The book-balance-equity cluster gives the focus book an exploratory resonance of measured relational order.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled target-reaching root, the earth/self landing pair, and the record-before-bringing-forth sequence formed a compact event pipeline; context then exposed its cosmological, affective, agential, and public-order functions without forcing them into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The revealed book in 57:25 may be functionally distinct from the antecedent event record, so measured public-order resonance should remain qualified.
The earth life-cycle may frame the focus occurrence without broadening the lexical scope of calamity itself.
The directional ق ب ل overlay and the non-dominant ن ص ب allotment activation are traceable but should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Affliction is a targeted arrival within prior inscription.** ص و ب B003 is aiming at and hitting a target, and B004 an affliction that hits a person. ك ت ب B003 supplies inscription as binding decree, while ق ب ل B002 supplies priorness. The packet supplies hit + prior record; I infer the event’s arrival follows a bounded placement -> it is not random drift. **أصاب/مصيبة** reads as directed incidence without making the sufferer its author.
2. **Bringing forth is separation from a prior state.** ب ر ء B001 is creation and bringing into being, while B002 is clearance and separation. The pronoun in **نبرأها** follows both earthly and inward occurrences. The packet supplies prior book and later bringing-forth; I infer inscription -> separation into event. Creation here reads as releasing an occurrence from prior measure into experienced reality.
3. **Ease is readiness of opening.** ي س ر B001 is ease and ready opening. After the book-to-event movement, **يسير** evaluates the whole transfer. The packet supplies ordered emergence; I infer complete prior measure -> unobstructed realization. Divine ease is thus procedural readiness, not trivialization of human pain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:23 immediately discloses the intended affective consequence: the claim is meant to loosen grief and exultation. 57:25’s balance later prevents this measured-order reading from becoming moral indifference.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Affliction as an arrival that hits its course.** Repeated `ص و ب` activates **B004**, an affliction that hits a person, and dormant **B003**, aiming at a target and reaching the intended course. Prior earth-revival and plant decay in 57:17/20 provide patterned events; 57:23 immediately states an affective purpose, and 57:25 introduces measure and justice. The packet supplies hit, prior inscription, and later purpose; I infer direction from those relations, not from **B003** alone. The event consequently reads as a routed arrival rather than an unstructured collision, without inferring that its local purpose is fully visible.
2. **From joined inscription to separated occurrence.** `ك ت ب` **B001** supplies joining and **B003** binding inscription/decree. For `ب ر ء` **B001**, both accepted variants share creation and bringing into being; dormant **B002** adds clearance and separation. “In a book” precedes “before We bring it into being.” The packet supplies that order; I infer that creation separates a particular occurrence out from a joined inscription into actuality. The ayah therefore presents events as staged realization, not a record written after impact.
3. **Ease belongs to opening the prepared route.** `ي س ر` **B001** supplies ease and ready opening. The garden is prepared in 57:21, this event is inscribed before realization, and 57:23 discloses its emotional use. The packet supplies preparation, inscription, and purpose; I infer that what is already ordered presents no obstructed passage into occurrence. “Easy” thus reads as frictionless enactment of prior arrangement, not a comment on the event's felt severity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 57:23 supplied an explicit emotional purpose and therefore corrected the “targeted hit” reading: direction is retained, but exhaustive knowledge of each local purpose is not. 57:27's “We did not prescribe it” later distinguished binding inscription from human institution, sharpening `ك ت ب` **B003** rather than making every occurrence or practice equivalent.

baseline.text: Ne yerde ne de kendi canlarınızda meydana gelen hiçbir felaket yoktur ki biz onu yaratmadan önce bir kitapta yazılı olmasın. Bu Allah için kolaydır.

findings.text: Felaketin gelmesi, önceden yazılmış bir düzen içinde hedeflenen seyrine ulaşan bir varıştır; bu yönlülük, her olayın yerel amacının insanlarca bütünüyle bilindiği anlamına gelmez.
Yaratma, olayı sonradan kayda geçirmek değil, birleşik ve bağlayıcı yazıdaki belirli bir oluşu ayırıp yaşanan gerçekliğe çıkarmaktır.
Bunun Allah için kolay olması, felaketin insanlar için hafif olduğu değil, önceden ölçülmüş oluşun gerçekleşme yolunun Allah açısından engelsiz olduğu anlamına gelir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Events are fixed before they strike, and knowledge of that inscription narrows the emotional swing between missed possession and received gift.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Calamity behaves like a projectile reaching its target, while what escapes is a literal gap; the prior record reframes both hit and miss as measured trajectories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Impact Is Entered Before It Lands
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A target-like event arrives as a calamity only after its occurrence has already been inscribed and measured before creation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a projectile or act reaching its target `quranic:root_000889:B003/m01`; calamity as a striking event `quranic:root_000889:B004/m01`; written document `quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`; inscription that imposes a decree or measure `quranic:root_001283:B003/m01`; bringing into creation `quranic:root_000099:B001/m01`; ease `quranic:root_001694:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The event is first an entry in a record and then an impact in the world or self. Its projectile sense gives calamity a trajectory, while inscription establishes that the apparent collision belongs to a prior measure and is therefore easy to encompass.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yağmurun yukarıdan aşağı inişini, bu inişle ilişkili bulutu ve inen şeyin yerine yerleşmesini aynı çekirdekte toplar. Bu yüzden dal yağmur örneklerini merkeze alır; doğruluk, hedefe varma, kötü olay ve acı bitki özü anlamlarını dışarıda tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yağmur ve yukarıdan iniş çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; doğruluk veya hedefe varma anlamı buraya taşınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem yalın adlar hem yağmurun bir yere inmesi gibi bağlı kullanımlar vardır; tanım bu iki alanı ayırarak verir.

concept_map.definition: Yukarıdan aşağı inen, özellikle yağmur olarak gelen ve indiği yerde yerleşen şeydir; bulut adı bu yağış getirme özelliğine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir şeyin yukarıdan aşağıya inip karar kılmasıdır.

Yağış getiren bulut, yağmur indirme özelliğiyle aynı adlandırma alanına girer.
Yağmurun belirli bir yere inmesi, çekirdeğin yer bildiren bağlı kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, söz veya işin yanlışın karşısında doğru olmasıdır.
Doğru olan şey kendi içinde övülen ve uygun görülen bir nitelik taşır.
Amaç güden kişinin amacına ulaşması, doğruluk değerinin bağlamsal bir gerçekleşmesidir.
Birine doğru yaptığını söylemek veya bir davranışı doğru saymak bu değer yargısını uygular.
İşin yerine oturması, doğruluk çekirdeğine bağlı bir kararlılık örneği olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde bu dalı yanlışın karşıtı olan doğru değerle açıklar; bazı açıklamalar bunu övülür uygunluk ve amaçlanan sonuca erişme açısından genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi yakalayan kötü olay, bu olaydan etkilenmiş kişi ve akılda görülen bozulma çizgisini açıkça verir. Daldaki kötü olay anlamı hedefe varma alanından türemiş bir geçmiş açıklamaya bağlanabilir, fakat güncel kavram sınırı insanın başına gelen sıkıntıdır.

Akılda eksiklik veya bozulma bulunması, etkilenmiş olma alanının özel kullanımıdır.
Bir açıklama kötü olay adını hedefe varma örneğinden özelleşmiş sayar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aşağı eğim, kap veya baş gibi şeyleri alçaltma ve koşuya salma örneğini aynı aşağı yönlü hareket alanına bağlar. Dal yağmurun kendiliğinden inişi değildir; daha çok bir nesneyi aşağı yöneltme veya aşağı eğimli olma sınırında kalır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi küçük yığın, dökülüp bir araya gelmiş şey ve hurma konulan yer anlamlarını açıkça verir. Bu dal yağmur veya bitki özü değil, maddelerin yığılmış durumu ve kimi yerde bu yığının yeriyle ilgilidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yığılmış kütle veya onun yeriyle sınırlıdır; yağmur, doğruluk ve bitki özü anlamları buraya katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalın bir adla sınırlıdır; tanım bağlı ifadeye dayanarak genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Toprak, para, hurma veya başka şeylerden oluşan dökülüp yığılmış küçük kütle ya da böyle bir yığının bulunduğu yer anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, dökülerek veya bir araya gelerek oluşmuş yığındır.
Toprak veya başka maddeden yapılmış küçük kütle bu çekirdeği gösterir.
Hurma konulan yer, yığın veya ürün biriktirme yeri olarak kullanılır.
Dökülmüş paraların yığın halinde olması örnek olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yığılmış kütle anlamını ortak biçimde verir; hurma yeri ve dökülmüş para örnekleri, aynı yığılma veya biriktirme alanının özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

error_profile.preserves: Dökülme ve yığın oluşma çekirdeği korunur.
error_profile.loses: Hurma yeri gibi yer bildiren kullanımı tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hurma konulan veya kurutulan yer anlamı gerektiğinde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma ve biriktirme yeri ilişkisi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dökülmüş paraların birikmiş kütle halinde bulunduğu örnekte uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Para ve yığın örneği korunur.

error_profile.preserves: Başka yalın ad dalını çağırır.
error_profile.loses: Yığın ve yer anlamlarını karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yığının oluşmasını genelleştirir; bu dal yığın adını hurma yeri ve dökülmüş şey örnekleriyle sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Toprak, hurma yeri veya dökülmüş para gibi maddesel yığını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yiyecek, hayvan veya insan topluluğu gibi daha geniş toplanmış kümeleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir araya gelmiş kütle veya topluluk fikrini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal somut yığılmış madde ve yer örneklerine bağlıdır; komşu dal canlı topluluklarına kadar genişler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dökülmüş veya biriktirilmiş yığını ve hurma yerini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Toprak veya çamurun toplanıp yükselmiş tepecik olmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da toprak veya madde birikmesiyle oluşan kütleyi paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yığılmış şeyin türünü açık bırakır; komşu dal yükselmiş tepecik görüntüsünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yığın, tepecik, kütle, ölçü ve toplanmış küme komşuları değerlendirildi; yalnız örtüşme sınırını açıklayanlar seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı tek kaynaklı, ses değişimi başlığı altında verilen eğilme ve kötülükten ayrılma kullanımı olarak sunar. Dal korunabilir, fakat yağmur, doğruluk veya hedefe varma gibi ana dalların yalın anlamı olarak genelleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ses değişimi kaydıyla sınırlı eğilme ve sapmadır; ana kök anlamlarına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eğilme kullanımı ve kötülükten ayrılma ifadesi birlikte verilir; tanım ikisini ses değişimi sınırında tutar.

concept_map.definition: Ses değişimi başlığı altında verilen eğilme, yana sapma veya kötülükten geri durup ayrılma kullanımıdır; bu dal genel doğruluk ya da hedefe varma anlamına taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, bir yönden eğilme veya yana sapmadır.
Kötülükten ayrılma veya ondan geri durma bu sapma alanının değer bağlamlı kullanımıdır.
Kullanım tek kaynakta ses değişimi başlığı altında sınırlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal, eldeki kanıtta ses değişimi kaydıyla açıklanan sınırlı bir eğilme ve sapma kullanımıdır; genel kök anlamı olarak genişletilmemelidir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak, eğilme ve kötülükten ayrılma kullanımını ses değişimi başlığı altında verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ses değişimi kaydıyla verilen eğilme veya doğrultudan ayrılma anlamı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eğilme ve sapma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kötülükten ayrılma bağlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kötülükten ayrılma veya ona yönelmeme anlamı öne çıktığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kötülükten ayrılma ve uzak durma ilişkisi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalın eğilme veya yana kayma anlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eğilme ve yandan sapma korunur.

error_profile.loses: Eğilme, sapma ve ses değişimi sınırını siler.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir yönden veya şeyden ayrılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal sapmayı genel biçimde taşır; bu dal yalnız ses değişimi kaydıyla gelen sınırlı kullanımdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eğilme ve kötülükten ayrılma kullanımı tek kaynak sınırındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yoldan veya haktan sapma, kaçınma ve geri durma alanını daha ayrıntılı verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da doğrultudan ayrılma ve sapma fikrini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sınırlı bir ses değişimi kaydıdır; komşu dal sapma ve kaçınma alanını kendi başına kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hedefe yönelme ve sapmadan varma yönünü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yön ve amaç ekseninde karşılaştırılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çizgiden ayrılmayı anlatır; komşu dal çizgiyi koruyup hedefe varmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşağı eğme ve alçaltma anlamındadır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yana ayrılma eksenindedir; komşu dal aşağı yönlü alçaltma eksenindedir.

source_note.MQ: Tek kaynak, eğilme ve kötülükten ayrılma kullanımını ses değişimi başlığı altında verir.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çevresinde aşağı iniş ve hedefe yönelme imgeleri yağmur, doğruluk, varma, kötü olay ve alçaltma dallarına açılır; ayrıca seçkin saf öz, acı bitki özsuyu, yığın ve ses değişimine bağlı sapma gibi ayrı dallar bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın kimliği, bir şeyi dik ve belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirme veya yükseltme çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır. Boynuz, göğüs ve baş gibi bölümlerin dik durması ile tozun yükselmesi aynı uzamsal görünümün geçişsiz gerçekleşmeleridir; perde kaldırma ve tuzak kurma ise belirli nesnelerle sınırlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca fiziksel dikme, dik durma ve yükselme alanındadır; tapınma taşı, pay, yorgunluk ve öteki dalların özel anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dikme ve dik durma çekirdeğini özel nesnelerle kurulan perde kaldırma, tuzak kurma ve kazan desteği gibi kullanımlardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi dik, çıkıntılı veya belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirmek ya da yükseltmek; ayrıca bir varlığın veya bölümünün bu biçimde dik durmasıdır. Tozun yükselmesi ve belirli nesnelerin kurulması bu uzamsal çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi dik, çıkıntılı veya belirgin duracak biçimde yerleştirme ya da yükseltme.
Bir insanın, hayvanın, boynuzun veya göğsün dik ve yükselmiş durumda bulunması.
Toz gibi dağınık bir maddenin havaya yükselerek belirginleşmesi.
Perdeyi kaldırma, av için tuzak kurma veya kazanı taşıyacak demir desteği yerleştirme gibi nesneye bağlı uygulamalar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Anlamın ortak çekirdeği, bir şeyi dik ve görünür konuma getirme ile bu konumda bulunmadır. Nesne örnekleri mızrak, yapı, taş, perde ve tuzağı; durum örnekleri ise dik boynuz, yükselmiş göğüs ve havaya kalkmış tozu kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel bir nesnenin dik konuma getirilmesini veya bir varlığın dik ve yükselmiş durumda bulunmasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Geçişli dikme işlemini ve geçişsiz dik durma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mızrak, taş, direk, yapı veya benzeri bir nesne dik konuma getirildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneyi dik ve belirgin konuma getiren fiziksel işlemi tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir insanın, hayvanın ya da beden bölümünün yükselmiş ve dik durumda bulunmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı veya beden bölümü için dik ve yükselmiş durumu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tozun yerden kalkıp havada belirginleştiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tozun yukarı doğru hareket edip görünür hâle gelmesini korur.

boynuzu dik veya göğsü yüksek dişi hayvan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir nesneyi dik konuma getiren geçişli işlemi ve toz gibi şeylerin yükselmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yerde veya bir şey üzerinde sabit kalma, bağlanma ve sıkıca yapışma anlamlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın dik veya yükselmiş durumda bulunmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın merkezi yerleştirme ve yükseltmedir; komşu dalın merkezi ise dik duruşla birlikte sabitlik ve bir yere bağlı kalmadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; çoğu yalnızca diklik senaryosunu paylaşan nesne, özel kullanım veya diğer kök anlamıdır. Okur açısından en yakın sınır karışıklığını dikilme ve sabit kalma adayı verir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نصب الشيء وإقامته ورفعه قائما، كنصب الرمح والبناء والحجر والستر والشرك، وقيام الشخص أو الحيوان منتصب الرأس أو القرن أو الصدر، وارتفاع الغبار ونحوه

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal, dikilmiş taşın tapınma, çevresinde dönme, adak kesme veya kan dökme amacıyla kullanılan kutsal nesne oluşunu doğru biçimde birleştirir. Taşın yalnızca dikili olması yeterli değildir; dinsel yönelim ya da kesim işlevi anlamın ayırt edici koşuludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Sıradan sınır taşı, kuyu çevresi taşı veya başka bir dikili nesne bu dala ancak tapınma ya da adak kesme işlevi varsa girer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın taş adını dinsel işleviyle verir ve başka dallardaki sıradan dikili taş anlamlarını bu çekirdeğe katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tapınmak, çevresinde dönmek, yakınlık sunmak veya üzerinde adak kesip kan dökmek için dikilmiş taş ya da bu tür taşlardan oluşan kutsal nesnedir.

facets.statement: Tapınılmak veya çevresinde dinsel tören yapılmak üzere dikilmiş taş.
Üzerinde adak hayvanı kesilen veya kan dökülen dikili taş.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, taşın dikilmiş olmasını tapınma ve kesim törenleriyle birlikte verir. Taş hem tapınılan bir nesne hem de adak hayvanının kesildiği ve kanının döküldüğü tören odağı olabilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinsel amaçla dikilmiş, tapınılan ya da üzerinde adak hayvanı kesilen taş için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın dikili oluşunu ve tapınma ya da kesim işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Taşın doğrudan kutsal nesne sayılıp kendisine tapınıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dikili taşın doğrudan tapınma nesnesi olmasını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın taş üzerinde kesildiği veya kanının taş üzerine döküldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taşın kesim ve kan dökme törenindeki özel işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, taşla sınırlı olmayan tapınma nesnelerini ve putları daha genel biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanların tapındığı cansız ve kutsallaştırılmış bir nesneyi kapsayabilir.
